full_judgment: 8. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the petitioner could not point out any material from the record to show that the findings arrived at by the High Court Division are the result of misreading or non-consideration of any material evidence as well as misconception of law. Therefore, we find no ground to interfere with the impugned judgment and order passed by the High Court Division.
